---
title: "Player Health Surveillance Results"
subtitle: "`r params$competition_name`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%d %B %Y')`"
params:
  competition_name: "Competition"
  results_dir: "."
  suppression_note: ""
  methods_note: !r character()
  include_notes: true
output:

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(flextable)
library(officer)

res_dir <- params$results_dir

flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family = "Open Sans Light",
  font.size   = 9,
  padding     = 3
)

thin_border <- officer::fp_border(color = "black", width = 0.3)


# Read a result file. Values are already formatted by the analysis, so nothing
# is rounded or reformatted here - the report displays what the analysis wrote.
read_result <- function(name) {
  readr::read_csv(
    file.path(res_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
}


# Does a result file exist? Some are only written when there is something to
# report.
has_result <- function(name) {
  file.exists(file.path(res_dir, paste0(name, ".csv")))
}


# Look a value up by name rather than by position. The previous version indexed
# results as df[4, 11], which silently returns the wrong number as soon as a row
# or column order changes upstream.
result_value <- function(data, key, key_column = 1, value_column = 2) {

  match <- data[[value_column]][data[[key_column]] == key]

  if (length(match) == 0) return(NA_character_)

  as.character(match[1])
}


# Standard table styling: no borders except a rule above and below the body,
# first column left aligned, the rest centred.
style_ft <- function(ft) {

  ncols <- flextable::ncol_keys(ft)

  ft <- ft %>%
    theme_zebra() %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    bg(part = "header", bg = "white") %>%
    bold(part = "header", bold = FALSE) %>%
    align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
    hline_top(part = "header", border = thin_border) %>%
    hline_top(part = "body", border = thin_border) %>%
    hline_bottom(part = "body", border = thin_border) %>%
    set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit")

  # A one-column table has nothing to centre, and 2:1 would reverse the columns.
  if (ncols > 1) {
    ft <- align(ft, j = 2:ncols, align = "center", part = "all")
  }

  ft
}


# A two-column metric/value table with no header row.
value_table <- function(data) {
  flextable(data) %>%
    style_ft() %>%
    delete_part(part = "header") %>%
    hline_top(part = "body", border = thin_border)
}


# A pattern table: incidence, severity and burden through the taxonomy.
#
# `labels` names each level in order, outermost first. The first is bold, the
# last italic, and each is indented one step further than the last. One
# function serves both the body-area and tissue-type tables, which were
# sixty near-identical lines each.
pattern_table <- function(data, labels, footnote = NULL) {

  levels_present <- sort(unique(data$level))

  header_normal <- fp_text(font.family = "Open Sans Light", font.size = 9)
  header_bold   <- fp_text(font.family = "Open Sans Light", font.size = 9, bold = TRUE)
  header_italic <- fp_text(font.family = "Open Sans Light", font.size = 9, italic = TRUE)

  # The first header cell lists the levels on separate lines, indented to match
  # the body rows beneath them.
  chunks <- list()

  for (i in seq_along(labels)) {

    props <- if (i == 1) {
      header_bold
    } else if (i == length(labels)) {
      header_italic
    } else {
      header_normal
    }

    chunks <- c(chunks, list(as_chunk(paste0(strrep("\u00A0", (i - 1) * 5), labels[i]),
                                      props = props)))

    if (i < length(labels)) chunks <- c(chunks, list("\n"))
  }

  ft <- flextable(data)

  # Body formatting by level. Row indices rather than formulas, so the level
  # values are taken from the data and not from the calling environment.
  for (i in seq_along(levels_present)) {

    rows <- which(data$level == levels_present[i])
    if (length(rows) == 0) next

    if (i == 1) {
      ft <- bold(ft, i = rows, j = "label", bold = TRUE)
      ft <- bg(ft, i = rows, j = 1:ncol(data), bg = "grey95", part = "body")
    } else {
      ft <- padding(ft, i = rows, j = "label", padding.left = (i - 1) * 10)
      ft <- italic(ft, i = rows, j = "label",
                   italic = i == length(levels_present))
      ft <- bg(ft, i = rows, j = 1:ncol(data), bg = "white", part = "body")
    }
  }

  ft %>%
    style_ft() %>%
    # Alignment applied before the level column is dropped: estimates right,
    # intervals left, so each pair reads as one value.
    align(j = 2,          align = "left",  part = "all") %>%
    align(j = c(4, 6, 8), align = "right", part = "all") %>%
    align(j = c(5, 7, 9), align = "left",  part = "all") %>%
    hline_top(part = "body", border = thin_border) %>%
    delete_columns(j = "level") %>%
    merge_at(j = 3:4, part = "header") %>%
    merge_at(j = 5:6, part = "header") %>%
    merge_at(j = 7:8, part = "header") %>%
    compose(part = "header", j = 1, value = do.call(as_paragraph, chunks)) %>%
    compose(part = "header", j = 2,
            value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Cases\n(n)", props = header_normal))) %>%
    compose(part = "header", j = 3,
            value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Incidence\n[95% CI]", props = header_normal))) %>%
    compose(part = "header", j = 5,
            value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Median time loss\n(IQR)", props = header_normal))) %>%
    compose(part = "header", j = 7,
            value = as_paragraph(as_chunk("Burden\n[95% CI]", props = header_normal))) %>%
    align(j = 1,   align = "left",   part = "header") %>%
    align(j = 2:8, align = "center", part = "header") %>%
    valign(valign = "bottom", part = "header") %>%
    font(part = "body", fontname = "Open Sans Light") %>%
    fontsize(part = "body", size = 9) %>%
    add_footer_lines(values = c(footnote, params$suppression_note)) %>%
    font(part = "footer", fontname = "Open Sans Light") %>%
    fontsize(part = "footer", size = 7) %>%
    align(align = "left", part = "footer") %>%
    autofit()
}


# Top rows of a distribution, for the potential injury breakdowns.
top_rows <- function(name, n = 3, label = "") {

  data <- read_result(name) %>% slice_head(n = n)

  names(data) <- c(label, "n", "%")

  flextable(data) %>% style_ft()
}
```

\pagebreak

**Risk matrix: incidence rate against average severity of time-loss injuries. The darker the background, the greater the burden. The curved isobars mark equal burden, in days lost per 1000 hours. Vertical and horizontal bars are 95% confidence intervals; a bar running to the panel edge extends beyond it. Severity here is the mean time loss per case, because burden is incidence multiplied by mean severity; the tables report medians.**


**Number of injuries by body area and time lost from football**

```{r}
severity <- read_result("severity_by_body_area")

numeric_columns <- names(severity)[-1]

palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#084594"))(100)
range_all <- range(unlist(severity[numeric_columns]), na.rm = TRUE)

if (!all(is.finite(range_all)) || range_all[1] == range_all[2]) {
  range_all <- c(0, max(1, range_all[2], na.rm = TRUE))
}

# Shade each cell by its value on one scale across the whole table.
shade <- function(values) {
  scaled <- (values - range_all[1]) / (range_all[2] - range_all[1])
  list(
    fill = ifelse(is.finite(scaled), palette[pmax(1, pmin(100, floor(scaled * 99) + 1))], "#FFFFFF"),
    scaled = scaled
  )
}

ft <- flextable(severity)
ft <- bg(ft, j = 1, bg = "#FFFFFF", part = "body")

for (column in numeric_columns) {

  shading <- shade(severity[[column]])

  ft <- bg(ft, j = column, bg = shading$fill, part = "body")

  dark <- which(is.finite(shading$scaled) & shading$scaled >= 0.78)
  if (length(dark) > 0) ft <- color(ft, i = dark, j = column, color = "#FFFFFF")
}

total_row <- which(severity[[1]] == "Total")
total_col <- which(names(severity) == "Total")

ft <- ft %>%
  bold(i = total_row, j = 1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  bold(j = total_col, part = "header", bold = TRUE) %>%
  align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 2:ncol(severity), align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#FFFFFF") %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = thin_border) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = thin_border) %>%
  set_header_labels(osiics_16_level_1 = "") %>%
  border(i = total_row, border.top = thin_border, border.bottom = thin_border,
         part = "body") %>%
  set_table_properties(width = 1, layout = "autofit")

ft
```

```{r results='asis'}
# Draft methods text, assembled from the settings actually in force.
# Passages marked [CHECK] need a figure or a decision the settings cannot supply.

if (length(params$methods_note) > 0) {

  cat("\n\\pagebreak\n\n")
  cat("**Suggested methods text**\n\n")
  cat("A draft, assembled from the settings this analysis actually used. ",
      "Passages marked [CHECK] need a figure or a decision that the settings ",
      "cannot supply - most of them are in the run notes below.\n\n", sep = "")

  cat(paste(params$methods_note, collapse = "\n\n"), "\n\n")
}
```

```{r results='asis'}
# Appendix: the narrative lines from each script's run notes.
#
# The brief notes hold the narrative only. The full notes, which include the
# case-level tables behind each check, stay in the results folder.

if (isTRUE(params$include_notes)) {

  notes <- c(
    "Data preparation and exposure" = "notes_exposure_brief",
    "Analysis"                      = "notes_analysis_brief",
    "Potential injuries"            = "notes_potential_injuries_brief",
    "Figures"                       = "notes_figures_brief"
  )

  cat("\n\\pagebreak\n\n")
  cat("**Appendix: run notes**\n\n")
  cat("Written by the analysis scripts as they run. They record the settings in ",
      "force, every exclusion and the reason for it, and the data-quality checks. ",
      "The tables behind each check are in the full notes in the results folder.\n\n",
      sep = "")

  for (title in names(notes)) {

    path <- file.path(res_dir, paste0(notes[[title]], ".txt"))
    if (!file.exists(path)) next

    cat("\n*", title, "*\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("```\n", paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"), "\n```\n",
        sep = "")
  }
}
```
